original_value: The purpose of this study is to develop a Student Opinion Scale Related to Moodle LMS (Learning Management System) in an Educational Online Learning Environment. For this purpose, a scale form consisting of 34 items was created and then administered to a total of 280 first-year students from various departments of the Near East University Health Services Vocational High School. Rotated principal component analysis was used to obtain information on the validity of the scale. The data was processed using the SPSS 23.0 software package and the results are given as arithmetic average and standard deviation. In this context, it has been determined that the related items for the scale are collected in 6 dimensions, which have been categorized by the researchers as: Proficiency and Motivation"; "Content and Feedback"; "Usability"; "Effectiveness"; "Educational Features" and “Communication". Additionally, the reliability coefficient calculated by Cronbach's alpha for the developed scale is .94. Based on the overall results of the study, student opinion has been found to be positive related to Moodle LMS in an Educational Online Learning Environment.

result.paraphrase: The aim of this study was to develop a Student Opinion Scale for Moodle LMS (Learning Management System) in an educational online learning environment. To do so, a 34-item scale was prepared and administered to 280 first-year students from different departments of the Near East University Health Services Vocational High School. Rotated principal component analysis was employed to examine the scale’s validity. The data were analyzed with SPSS 23.0, and the findings are presented as mean and standard deviation. In this regard, the scale’s items were found to cluster into 6 dimensions, labeled by the researchers as Proficiency and Motivation, Content and Feedback, Usability, Effectiveness, Educational Features, and Communication. In addition, Cronbach’s alpha reliability coefficient for the scale was .94. Overall, the study showed that student opinion toward Moodle LMS in an Educational Online Learning Environment was positive.
